result.title: AlphaBet: Reinforcement Learning for LLM Event Forecasting Agents
result.summary: Forecasting an unresolved event requires finding relevant evidence and deciding how strongly it supports each outcome. Yet outcome-based training of Large Language Model (LLM) forecasters often begins with preassembled evidence at a single prediction date, leaving evidence acquisition outside the learning loop. We introduce AlphaBet, an agentic reinforcement learning (RL) framework that trains a single LLM policy to search, reason, and report probabilities across multiple pre-resolution dates. Each dated forecast is scored by a proper scoring rule against the eventual outcome, allowing one resolved event to supervise decisions under different information states. We decompose forecasting regret into an evidence-acquisition gap and a probability-reporting gap, and show that Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)'s standard-deviation normalization can distort the reporting target under multi-class proper scores. On GLM-4.5-Air, AlphaBet reduces the Brier score from 0.731 to 0.626 on Forecast-Dojo and from 0.612 to 0.528 on FutureX. Controlled ablations attribute these gains to multi-date training and show that they come from improvements in both information acquisition and probability reporting. Our empirical results validate that GRPO's std normalization degrades proper-scoring-rule performance while leaving top-outcome accuracy largely unchanged.

AI.brief_summary: AlphaBet 提出面向 LLM 事件预测智能体的强化学习框架，训练单一策略在多个预测日期上检索证据、推理并输出概率，按恰当评分规则评分，并分析了 GRPO 标准差归一化对多类评分目标的扭曲。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽为纯文本事件预测，但把证据获取纳入训练回路、用多日期轨迹在不同信息状态下监督决策，并提供「证据获取缺口 / 概率报告缺口」的分解，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的证据获取与轨迹监督贡献分配提供方法线索，可供核查。
